questions.question: The fifteenth day of the month of June is a Saturday. What will be the last day of the next month which has 31 days?
questions.solution:
The fifteenth day of the month of June is a Saturday.

Saturday falls on these dates:

15 + 7 = 22

22 + 7 = 29

And the last day of June, i.e, 30 June is Sunday.

And 1st of July will be Monday.

Monday falls on these dates:

1 + 7 = 8

8 + 7 = 15

15 + 7 = 22

22 + 7 = 29

30th is Tuesday and 31st is Wednesday.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Wednesday"**.

questions.solution:

questions.question:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to sequentially replace the @ signs and to balance the given equation.

72 @ 9 @3 @ 6 @ 6 @ 6 @ 6
questions.solution:
Here, we use the BODMAS table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e10e3be1476caf1bd7e2e109842e7c57ce86da0c54b1b539e233e4e6a7748a44.png] 

Given:

⇒ 72 @ 9 @3 @ 6 @ 6 @ 6 @ 6

(1) ÷, ×, +, =, -, +

⇒ 72 @ 9 @3 @ 6 @ 6 @ 6 @ 6

After putting the signs:

⇒ __**72 ÷ 9**__ × 3 + 6 = 6 - 6 + 6

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 8 × 3 + 6 = 12 - 6

⇒ 24 + 6 = 6

⇒ 30 = 6

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

(2) **÷, ×, +, =, ×, -**

⇒ 72 @ 9 @3 @ 6 @ 6 @ 6 @ 6

After putting the signs:

⇒** __72 ÷ 9__** × 3 + 6 = __**6 × 6**__ - 6

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ __**8 × 3**__ + 6 = 36 - 6

⇒ 24 + 6 = 30

⇒ **30 = 30**

Here, the equation is **satisfied.**

(3) ×, ÷, =, -, +, ×

⇒ 72 @ 9 @3 @ 6 @ 6 @ 6 @ 6

After putting the signs:

⇒ 72 × __**9 ÷ 3**__ = 6 - 6 + __**6 × 6**__

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ __**72 × 3**__ = 6 - 6 + 36

⇒ 216 = 42 - 6

⇒ 216 = 36

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

(4) +. ×, =, -, ÷, +

⇒ 72 @ 9 @3 @ 6 @ 6 @ 6 @ 6

After putting the signs:

⇒ 72 + __**9 × 3**__ = 6 - __**6 ÷ 6**__ + 6

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 72 + 27 = 6 - 1 + 6

⇒ 99 = 12 - 1

⇒ 99 = 11

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".

questions.question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when placed from left to right in the following blanks, will complete the letter-series.

F G H _ Y _ G _ U Y F_ H _ Y F G _ W _

options.text: U F H G V I Y
T G H G V H Y
T F H G V H Y
U G H G V H Y

questions.solution:
**Given:**

F G H _ Y _ G _ U Y F_ H _ Y F G _ W _

Checking all the options:

1. U F H G V I Y

F G H U Y / F G H U Y / FG H V Y / F G I W Y

2. T G H G V H Y

F G H T Y / G G H U Y / FG H V Y / F G H W Y

**3. T F H G V H Y**

F G H **T** Y / F G H **U** Y / FG H **V** Y / F G H **W** Y

Here, the series is completed.

4. U G H G V H Y

F G H U Y / G G H U Y / FG H V Y / F G H W Y

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".

questions.question:
Three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and one is different. 

Pick the odd one out.
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba9641975f2fc7524ff111ee5de92ae0deecda54903f9932e1bcb1ebbbc99a46.png] 

**Logic: **First and Second letter are exactly opposite to each other; First letter - 2 = Third letter

 
• HSF → H ↔ S; H - 2 = F
 
• FUD → F ↔ U; F - 2 = D
 
• BYZ → B ↔ Y; B - 2 = Z
 
• JOH → J ↔ Q ≠ O; J - 2 = H

Hence, '**JOH**' is the correct answer.
